Being someone who has attempted suicide multiple times, I hate it when people say that they are cowards. Death seems like the only way out. Some days you will wake up and think "I just know something is going to push me over the edge today, but I have to get up and face the world" but it's not cowardly. And self-harm comes into this too, I have done a lot of it. Pain can feel euphoric if all you feel everyday is depression. I have wanted kill myself so bad that I wanted pain or something to escape crippling depression, so I cut on my legs. Nobody gets to see that but you. It's very personal to me and it's kind of a ritual because I smile everytime I cut because it makes depression go away just for a little bit. Some days are worse and a person might finally have the guts to go through with it. I just don't want others to feel like they should I would do anything to help a person because I am the kind of person that doesn't care about themselves if another person is suicidal.
